technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
U.S. technology for wet rock processing. No specific age of technology modelled

# Included processes
Mining process, transport to beneficiation plant, wet processing including screening, washing and flotation. No drying of calcination included. Land use for mining and reclamation.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data for emissions and land use based on various studies from Florida. Energy data based on a world-wide survey and some assumptions. Further data from literature and estimations.
